name: FSL BET Skull Strip
summary: Skull-strips a T1-weighted image with FSL bet using a configurable fractional intensity threshold and outputs the brain-extracted T1w.
description: Runs FSL bet on the T1w with -f frac inside the brainlife/fsl 6.0.4 container (robust centre estimation and bias/neck clean-up are not used). Use it as a simple, fast brain extraction; lower frac values give a larger brain outline.

outputs.description: Skull-stripped (brain-extracted) T1w image produced by FSL's bet (fractional intensity threshold only; -R disabled, see main).

parameters.description: BET fractional intensity threshold (0-1, default 0.5). Smaller values give larger brain outline estimates.

failure_modes.fix: Check the input T1w path and image.
